title: Page 195
transc:
White House 11 June 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
please tell me if possible what
line is to be built and
who is to build it also
where I am to go I
want time to get prepared answer
Bickford


Ft. Monroe June 12 1864 
R OBrien Genl Butters Hd Qrs
for Knox zodiac I have material ready
for extension of wrangle from James town
Smyrna peasant Swans vernon Cabin vernon Garysville
to the Apple mattocks zebra can we
now have the tarquin protection and assistance
for our building parties and the line
unity there appears to be call for
it now pekin will hurry it up
Geo D Sheldon


Hd Qrs A. US June 12 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Emily Cold Harbor June forbid for Knave unity go
on with the cord you Roy suggested by paradise
come stock pedlar a staff affair is or may
with letter of instructions to you but did not
leave here until last night zebra your Chief Randolph
will under stand the cord dear Roy meant Jersey
SH Beckwith
